recognize_zh: 中央的分節中性球細胞質佈滿粗大紫紅色毒性顆粒，細胞質右下緣有一塊淡藍色、邊界不清的斑塊，即 Döhle 小體。
features: Segmented neutrophil with coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules (toxic granulation)
Pale blue, irregular peripheral cytoplasmic inclusion at the lower right margin (Döhle body)
Background echinocytes/crenated red cells and a polychromatophilic red cell
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high magnification shows a segmented neutrophil with coarse, dark cytoplasmic granulation and a pale blue, ill-defined inclusion at the periphery of the cytoplasm, consistent with a Döhle body. Background red cells include occasional crenated cells and a polychromatophilic cell. Findings are consistent with toxic changes in neutrophils (toxic granulation and Döhle bodies), as seen in sepsis, inflammation, burns, pregnancy or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, spindle-shaped and more sharply outlined, present in most neutrophils without toxic granulation, with giant platelets.
Morulae are dark purple, stippled, berry-like clusters within neutrophil cytoplasm rather than a pale blue homogeneous patch.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark granules in all leukocyte types and are not accompanied by Döhle bodies.
